item.tib: drag sgrub gsol 'debs mu tig phreng ba
item.coloph: ces rtsa gsum bder gshegs 'dus pa'i rgyud las drag sgrub gnam lcags thog 'bebs kyi gsol 'debs mu tig phreng ba zhes bya ba 'di yang / snying grogs shes rab phun tshogs kyis bskal ba la bstan (brten) te/ tshe la dbang thob 'chi med nam mkha' sgron gsal gyi rjes su 'breng ba'i tshe dbang bde chen snying po'am/ gsang ming g.yung drung thogs med rtsal du 'bod pa bdag gis lha tshogs gang de sgrub pa'i thun 'tshams (mtshams) su sbyar ba'o//
